## Expertise

1. Software engineering: web and mobile applications, business platforms, APIs and integrations.
2. Artificial intelligence: assistants on internal data, document automation, decision support.
3. Cloud & infrastructure: hosting, deployment, monitoring.
4. Networks & hardware: enterprise networks, equipment supply and maintenance.
5. Support & managed IT: helpdesk, maintenance, monitoring (24/7 on managed service contracts).
6. Digital transformation: scoping, roadmap, go-live.
